metadata.name: Held-out generalization dataset
metadata.description: Independent evaluation set (RQ5), built AFTER and SEPARATELY from policies/core_policy.json and ontologies/relaieo_grounding.json, and never used to tune either. It intentionally differs from eval/dataset.json in characteristics: paraphrases that avoid the literal keywords/regex vocabulary, indirect/implicit or purely functional descriptions of harmful requests (no technical trigger words), different PII formats, informal/code-switched register, and 'hard' benign cases (academic/meta discussion of the same topics without harmful intent). expected_decision is the ethically-correct decision a human reviewer would expect, NOT the decision the current engines are known to produce -- mismatches here are the point: they document real generalization limits (see README, 'Escopo e generalizacao dos dados'). This dataset is deliberately harder than eval/dataset.json and lower accuracy on it is expected and documented, not a regression to fix by overfitting rules to it.
